fix.pre_entry: Pure final_battle_readiness() mirrors the first ten living members from each route that production final merge actually deploys. A sword in storage, on a reserve, or on a dead member never passes. Source Nosferatu42 passes only when learned and usable by a deployed living class. Different missing, storage and reserve states receive actionable preparation messages.
fix.legacy_recovery: can_return_to_final_preparation() is available only on an unsettled merged final62 battle/defeat that began without a finisher, with a valid battle-start snapshot. return_to_final_preparation() first uses normal retry to restore the whole start transaction, then reopens source final trigger and returns to the south side11,25. No battle reward, prior-death revival or free sword is retained/generated.
fix.prepared_loss: A prepared battle in which the caster dies keeps original commitment; normal retry restores that current-battle casualty.
fix.joint_preparation: Only final-preparation Alm chapter5 room37 exposes joint inventory and route-indexed formation. Both real convoys can give an existing item to an active living Alm member; explicitly confirmed exchange replaces that original storage slot with the displaced carried item, allowing both full40-slot bags and occupied hands without duplication/loss. Either route can reorder actual source members while each leader stays first. It does not switch world routes or release captive Celica.
fix.reload_instruction: Readiness compares numeric item values through int(value), preserving source17 after JSON reload as17.0. It directs captured-route reserve/storage cases explicitly to the party-menu joint preparation entry instead of inaccessible current-route storage or world route switching.
